load_weights_to_model: load model weights and dataset metadata from a checkpoint file into an MMPose model
inputs_to_list: convert image paths, video files, directories, or numpy arrays into a list for batch inference
get_webcam_inputs: set up a webcam generator that yields frames from a camera device for real-time pose inference
visualize_predictions: visualize pose estimation predictions with configurable keypoints, bounding boxes, and output directory
finalize_video_processing: finalize video processing by releasing the video writer and saving frame predictions to a JSON file
